spec_match.rationale: Creates three real AudioContexts (default / hardware / 256) and compares their real baseLatency and outputLatency readings, the exact observable the hint is meant to move.

interactive.rationale: One run button drives the three-config benchmark with per-card metrics, a comparison bar chart, and a prepend-ordered log.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card's promise matches the page's verified behaviour.

edge_cases.rationale: Fixed in this refile: a missing renderQuantumSize now renders '(not exposed)' plus an explanatory log line instead of the v151 behaviour of silently printing 128; per-config constructor errors log individually.

references.rationale: Links the ChromeStatus entry and the renderSizeHint spec section.

conformance.rationale: The new v153 feature suite ran in the verification browser at 5 pass / 4 fail / 0 blocked — the 4 fails are the shipped-attribute assertions, the honest 'not yet shipped' answer on Chromium 141 (anticipated Chrome 153), exactly as their descriptions state.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP page-driver run (headless Chromium 141): all three configs ran, quantum columns honestly read '(not exposed)', per-config not-exposed log lines rendered, best-latency highlight applied; console/network clean; screenshot v153-rq-bench.png read. Note: headless null-sink outputLatency reads 0.00 ms, so the comparison is degenerate in this environment.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts rq-benchmark-ran with exposedAny and bestKey after the three configs complete.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons that override background also override color; small-text emerald readouts darkened via color-mix to meet AA.

accessibility.rationale: Log box is role=log aria-live=polite with an aria-label; metric values are text; the run button disables during the run and re-enables after.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: deno task responsive-check v153/webaudio-configurable-render-quantum --no-server: desktop OK clean, mobile OK (sub-44px flags are inline links, primary buttons/sliders remain usable); both screenshots read and judged clean.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify on a build where the Chrome 153 flip has landed
openQuestions.detail: The verification browser (Chromium 141, no origin trial) does not expose renderQuantumSize, so every hint is honestly reported as ignored. Once a Chrome 153 stable (or a build launched with --enable-blink-features=WebAudioConfigurableRenderQuantum) is available, re-run the page and confirm the quantum readouts flip to real values and the four not-yet conformance assertions pass.

openQuestions.title: Confirm the latency comparison on real audio hardware
openQuestions.detail: Headless Chromium reports outputLatency 0.00 ms for every config (null audio sink), so the bars cannot differ here. On a machine with a real output device, verify the hardware-hint column actually reads differently once the feature ships.

guidanceConsulted.query: web audio start stop controls live metrics readout accessibility
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give async result areas polite live regions, keep state changes textual, and disable/re-enable controls around async work.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Benchmark log upgraded to role=log aria-live=polite; best result is marked by both color and the log's 'Best outputLatency' line.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Driver run: log carried the honest not-exposed lines and the best-key line

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let card grids collapse to one column on narrow viewports and keep wide code blocks scrolling inside their own container.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: bench-grid collapses to one column under 600px.

summary: v153 refile fixing a real v151 honesty defect: the quantum column no longer silently claims 128 when renderQuantumSize is missing — it reads '(not exposed)' with an explanatory log line. Small-text emerald log entries darkened for AA. Verified via CDP headless Chromium 141: three real configs, honest readouts, clean console/network.
